summary: Only Wang Xizhi’s (p028) Orchid Pavilion preface and gathering are securely dated. Sealed 永和九年，歲在癸丑，暮春之初 belongs to that event; Eastern Jin Mu’s Yonghe 9 is the guichou year AD 353. Late spring of that lunar year stays inside AD 353 in both Julian (Academia Sinica’s pre-1582 default) and proleptic Gregorian, so the year-precision Western year is justified. Every other owned date is unsupported. Xie An’s 未仕時 is a relative phrase, not a convertible year: 345–360 invents both ends and treats residence as a period window. 孫綽、李充、許詢、支遁 are named only as eastern literary peers; 永和九年 dates the gathering, and the passage does not name them there. p035’s Yonghe 9 row cites preface sentences that neither name 羲之 nor contain the year, duplicating p028’s event. 東晉永和前後 and 353–355 on the later anecdotes and the goose-keeping widow are not in the Chinese. 齊彭殤 and 金穀詩序 are later or proverbial references, not Peng Zu’s, Pan Yue’s, or Shi Chong’s living activity, and 296–300 is likewise absent. Owned units state no births, deaths, or numerical ages for the owned people. Active hints repeat the defective years and must be cleared or, for p035, reduced to the context-supported Yonghe 11 resignation rather than Lanting.

itemChecks.event: Wang Xizhi dated the Orchid Pavilion preface to Yonghe 9, the guichou year, at the start of late spring.
itemChecks.reason: The dated event is Wang Xizhi’s (p028) own preface. s0114 introduces 羲之自為之序; s0115 supplies 永和九年，歲在癸丑，暮春之初. Among repeated 永和 reign titles, 歲在癸丑 selects Eastern Jin Emperor Mu Sima Dan, Yonghe 9 = AD 353, not Han Shundi Yonghe 9. 暮春 of that lunar year remains AD 353; Academia Sinica’s converter defaults to Julian before 1582, and the fourth-century Julian versus proleptic-Gregorian difference is about one day, so the Western year does not move. Year precision is the right grain for this row: a reign-year-plus-season label does not, by itself, specify a Gregorian month-day.
